meta.title: Javi · A life in milestones
meta.description: Javi's life from 1980 to today as a sky of memories, with a book for his children and a clone to keep talking with him. Join a waitlist.

guide.title: How to read this sky
guide.cloud: A cloud is a memory; the bigger it is, the more it changed
guide.galaxy: A dotted circle is a period of my life; time runs from its core to its rim
guide.ring: A hollow ring is still ahead: the book and my clone
guide.dust: The fine dust is the days, thicker where more happened

hero.title: A life, in milestones.
hero.lede: I'm Javi. This is my life from 1980 to today: a cloud of dots per memory, a galaxy per stage. Explore it as you like. Ahead: a book for my children, and my clone, for those who want to keep talking with me.

origins.title: A Basque childhood.
origins.intro: A farmhouse, a flat, the mountains at weekends and camping in summer.

craft.title: Learning the trade.
craft.intro: Corporate teams first, then the web, then open source.

tapquo.title: A startup, a classroom and a plane.
tapquo.intro: I found a company, teach, write a book and leave Spain.

remote.title: Working from anywhere.
remote.intro: Remote before it was fashionable: teams, books, blockchain and a new habit.

home.title: A company, a family, a house.
home.intro: Satoshi, two children and a house I built.

now.title: Where I am.
now.intro: Still working out what I want to teach.

book.title: A book for my children.
book.body: It's for my children, and for anyone who wants it: my life, what I've learnt, what went well and what went wrong. Leave your email and I'll write to you when it's out.

clone.title: A place to keep talking.
clone.body: I'm building my clone, a version of me for whoever wants to keep talking with me when I'm no longer here, especially those who knew me. It isn't ready yet.
